newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Arab central bank governors to meet in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Arab central bank governors to meet in Morocco.

text.p: Arab central bank governors and heads of Arab League monetary agencies are to meet in Morocco on Thursday, an official of the Moroccan Bank Al-Maghrib (central bank) said on Wednesday.

Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj will chair the mainly closed talks which will look at a united Arab report for 1996 to be presented to the next annual meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank.
The meeting, the 20th annual session of the Council of Arab governors, will also examine developments in financial policy in member countries last year, the official said.
